content: Hatyaoseta Kalanero Mokose halalahitiya hiyalatyakalati, hatyo kakoita 7-hena. Halalaka hoka hatyaoseta enokoa nali mema tyaonaha, xakore hoka maisa waha xini.
Hatyaoseta nowaiya 7-hare anjonai, Enore haliya tityoita. Hatyaoseta 7-xaemahalikisakalati koneta kaxekaka enomanaha.

Hatyaoseta hatya anjo tinihaliti ouro nomakere incenso nitini kakoare tyoa tityoa incenso keratyaka aose haliya. Kahare incenso kaxekaka enomana hoka ahohisakoatya maheta tyotya Enore kaxaikone hotyali niraexala kakoare. Hoka ouro nomakere keratyakalati aose keratene maheta okahakalati haliya.
Enore haliya anjo tyaonitere kahekoata incenso keratyaka niye ainakoita manene Enore kaxaikone hotyali niraexala kakoare.

Hatyaoseta anjo iya tinihaliti incenso nitini hoka irikati iya incenso kakeratyakitere aoseta hoka irikati moka enako hoka waikohekoa xawatene. Hoka talolore, xakoti, kahihiye, exahe waikohekoa harenae hoka tatakoa.
Hatyaoseta 7-hare anjonai memere tyaonaha koneta aemahalikisaha maheta.

Hatyaoseta hetatiye anjo aemahalikisa koneta hoka irikati one sehalise kakoare, timalati kakoare, kaolatyoanexe exoa waikohekoa hoka keratya waikohe holinikoa. Atyakatenai, ime harenae hoka holini kera.
Hatyaoseta hatya anjo aemahalikisa koneta, hatyo kakoita hinamehena. Aemahalikisa hoka motya tyairi kiriterehare kaxawatyaka one kaloxere xaiya hoka holinixa one timalaxa tyaona.
Hoka holini waini onexa tyaoniterenae, exahe kanowa kalorexenai hoka holini kamawenekoaretyakaha.

Hatyaoseta hatya anjo aemahalikihitiya koneta, hatyo kakoita hanamehena. Aemahalikisa koneta hoka kalorexe xorese exoa enokoata, motya xaokanatyakalati kalorexe takoare. Exoa holini onexaiyanai, onesenai xoaha heno.
Hatyo xorese nexare atyo Tihero. Tihe hoka onexaiyanae, onesenae xoaha exoa hoka tihexa mokahene. Hiyeta hoka kahare haliti waini terehenaherene hiyeta.

Hatyaoseta hatya anjo aemahalikihitiya koneta, hatyo kakoita 4-hena. Aemahalikisa koneta hoka kamai, kaimare, xoresenae kakawe xomokaka hoka ferakoa hoka kamai maisa waiye aokanahenahitita. Makiya hoka nikare kaimare, xoresenai hoka maisa waiye aokanahenahititaha.

Hatyaoseta nawahakotya hoka nasema hatya aliwa eno ainakoita hoka kinatyaxa kawiyatya: — Maika waikohekoa tyaoniterenai kirakoane tyaonaha hanamaki hoka “Akai, akai, akai”, nehenaha, semehenaha koneta nemahare, hanama anjonae aemahalikihena hoka — nexa.
